title: Creamy French Mushroom Pasta
description: A delightful and creamy pasta dish loaded with sautéed shiitake mushrooms, perfect for a cozy dinner.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook pasta according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat.
Add the sliced shiitake mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Sprinkle the flour over the mushrooms and cook for 1 minute.
Slowly pour in the milk, whisking constantly to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until it thickens, about 2-3 minutes.
Stir in the broken macaron and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Season the sauce with salt and pepper to taste.
Drain the cooked pasta and return it to the pot.
Add the creamy mushroom sauce to the pasta and toss to combine.
Transfer the pasta to a serving dish and top with grated Parmesan cheese.
